description: This file defines data structures, function prototypes, and constants for handling reftable records, including string views, varint encoding/decoding, record vtable, and record management functions.

methods.name: string_view_consume
methods.description: Advances the buffer pointer by n bytes and decreases its length accordingly.

methods.name: reftable_record_init
methods.description: Initializes a reftable_record structure for a specific record type.

methods.name: reftable_record_cmp
methods.description: Compares two reftable records for ordering.

methods.name: reftable_record_equal
methods.description: Checks if two reftable records are equal.

methods.name: reftable_record_key
methods.description: Extracts the key from a reftable record.

methods.name: reftable_record_copy_from
methods.description: Copies data from one reftable record to another.

methods.name: reftable_record_val_type
methods.description: Returns the value type of a reftable record.

methods.name: reftable_record_encode
methods.description: Encodes a reftable record into a string view.

methods.name: reftable_record_decode
methods.description: Decodes data into a reftable record.

methods.name: reftable_record_is_deletion
methods.description: Checks if a record is a tombstone (deletion).

methods.name: reftable_record_release
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a reftable record.
